title: Climate and Surface Forcing
objective: Characterize atmospheric and surface forcing conditions that govern recharge and boundary-state evolution.
questions: How do climate variability and event dynamics shape groundwater-relevant forcing?
How should forcing uncertainty be propagated into subsurface simulations?

specialSections.title: Temporal Variation
specialSections.body: Resolve seasonal, sub-seasonal, and extreme-event timing effects on infiltration and recharge pulses.

specialSections.title: Spatial Variation
specialSections.body: Represent heterogeneity in rainfall and land-surface controls across field, catchment, and basin scales.

specialSections.title: Stochastic Forcing
specialSections.body: Generate uncertainty-aware forcing realizations for stress testing and robust downstream simulation.

specialSections.title: Land-Use and Surface Conditions
specialSections.body: Account for vegetation, imperviousness, roughness, and soil-cover impacts on runoff-infiltration partitioning.

specialSections.title: Boundary-Condition Generation
specialSections.body: Create consistent boundary-condition products for WP2-WP6 coupling and scenario replay.

specialSections.title: Validation Datasets
specialSections.body: Validate forcing products against station networks, remote-sensing retrievals, and curated benchmark archives.

tasks.title: Forcing Data Curation
tasks.summary: Assemble weather, land-surface, and hydroclimate observations for consistent modelling inputs.

tasks.title: Scenario Generation
tasks.summary: Construct historical, extreme-event, and climate-change forcing ensembles.

tasks.title: Boundary Packaging
tasks.summary: Publish boundary-condition products consumed by downstream work packages.
